[SWS_CM_90452] Default byte order for the length field of structs
Upstream requirements: RS_CM_00204
⌈If TransformationPropsToServiceInterfaceElementMapping.transfor-
mationProps.byteOrder is not defined, a byte order of mostSignificantByteFirst
shall be used for the length field.⌋
For the length field of serialization of optional members see [PRS_SOMEIP_00229].
Regarding structure members and serialization examples, refer to [4].
